messages.content: 你能給我標準差為10、樣本大小為50、樣本平均值為25的平均值95%信賴區間嗎？同樣的，你能為樣本大小為150的情況做同樣的事嗎？

function.name: confidence_interval_calculate
function.description: Calculate the confidence interval for a mean. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample.

confidence_level.description: The level of confidence. Default is 0.9. This is a float type value.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Can you give me the 95% confidence interval for the mean with standard deviation=10, sample size=50, sample mean=25? Also do same for sample size=150." We need to compute using t-distribution or normal approximation? For CI calculation we can use either z (normal) if population SD known; but they gave sample std dev as 10 - maybe it's estimated from data. Usually one uses t distribution when sigma unknown and n small (<30). But here n=50 >30 so approximate normal may suffice. However typical formula: CI = x̄ ± t_{α/2,n-1} * s / sqrt(n). Use t critical values.

We have two cases:

Case 1: n=50, df=49. t_crit at alpha=0.05 -> t(0.975,49)=~2.0096? Let's check actual t-critical: For df=49, t_(0.025) ~ 2.01. So margin error = 2.01*10/sqrt(50)=2.01*10/7.071=2.01*1.414=2.845 approx. Actually 10/sqrt(50)=10/7.07=1.414. Multiply by 2.01 gives about 2.84. So CI: [22.16,27.84].

Alternatively using z=1.96 yields ME=1.96*10/√50=1.96*1.414=2.77 giving [22.23,27.77]. Slight difference.

For case 2: n=150, df=149. t_critical close to 1.976? Actually t(0.975,149) ≈ 1.977. Margin error = 1.977*10/√150. √150≈12.247. 10/12.247=0.8165. times 1.977=1.615. So CI: [23.385,26.615] roughly.

If using z=1.96 then ME=1.96*10/12.247=1.60. So similar.

Thus answer: Provide intervals.

Also mention assumptions: Normality etc.
